records.json.asks: demographics, problems, allergies, medications, and immunizations

form-phq2.json.asks: demographics and the answers to the PHQ-2 form, sent inline

uscdi.json.asks: anything in the patient's record that conforms to US Core

form-by-reference.json.asks: the answers to the GAD-7 form, named by its URL only

form-versioned.json.asks: the answers to the PHQ-2 form, named with a version suffix and sent inline

form-semaglutide.json.asks: the answers to a physician-authored semaglutide check-in form, sent inline

observations.json.asks: recent lab results and vital signs, as US Core Observations

no-selector.json.asks: anything the patient thinks is relevant, with no selector

health-card.json.asks: immunizations, preferably as a SMART Health Card

unknown-selector.json.asks: demographics, and one item with a selector kind no wallet knows

testCases.title: Web wallet from the registry
testCases.summary: The Verifier lists the event's web wallets, opens the one the person picks, and exchanges the request and response with it by postMessage.
walletShows: The wallet shows the Verifier's origin during consent.
verifierShows: The Verifier lists every wallet in the registry, with the phone's own wallet alongside, and shows each item's status and data.

testCases.title: Native wallet through the Digital Credentials API
testCases.summary: The same check-in as M1, with a wallet app on the phone that the Verifier reaches through the browser's Digital Credentials API.
walletShows: The wallet shows the Verifier's origin during consent.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows each item's status and data.
testCases.notes: Record the phone, OS version, browser, and wallet app.

testCases.title: Insurance
testCases.summary: The wallet returns insurance as either requested coverage profile, in FHIR JSON or as a SMART Health Card, and the Verifier shows it either way.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows the member, payer, and plan from the returned Coverage, whichever profile or format the wallet chose.
If the wallet returns a SMART Health Card, the Verifier verifies its signature before showing it.

testCases.title: Pre-visit questionnaire, inline
testCases.summary: The wallet fills in a form sent inline, and its QuestionnaireResponse names exactly the requested form.
walletShows: The wallet renders the inline form.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows each answer next to its question.

testCases.title: One item declined
testCases.summary: The person declines one item and shares the rest, and the Verifier tells a declined item from an error.

walletStep.text: Decline Immunizations and share everything else.

verifierShows: The Verifier shows Immunizations as declined, not as an error, and the rest normally.

testCases.title: Nothing to share
testCases.summary: Every item comes back declined or unavailable, and the check-in still ends cleanly.

walletStep.text: Decline every item, or use a wallet whose patient has no insurance on file.

verifierShows: The Verifier handles every item declined or unavailable without breaking the page, and the patient can continue without the wallet.

testCases.title: Anything in USCDI, small patient
testCases.summary: A request for anything in US Core, answered with a modest record of whatever resource types the wallet holds.
walletShows: The wallet lets the patient choose what to include.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows every returned resource, whatever the resource types.

testCases.title: Anything in USCDI, large patient
testCases.summary: A patient with years of history, to test that a response over 1 MB arrives intact.

walletStep.text: Answer as a patient with a large record.

verifierShows: The Verifier shows the whole record.
testCases.notes: On Android, the wallet returns the response with the three-argument `setGetCredentialResponse`, which passes it to the browser as a file ([Platform notes](https://smart-health-checkin.org/spec/platform-notes.html#android)). Record the browser, phone, and wallet version.

testCases.title: Questionnaire by reference only
testCases.summary: The wallet fetches a form that the request names by its URL only, with no copy inline.
walletShows: The wallet renders the fetched form, or reports the item unsupported rather than inventing a form.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows the answers.

testCases.title: Versioned canonical
testCases.summary: The request names the form with a version suffix (|1), and the QuestionnaireResponse echoes that versioned name exactly.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows the answers.

testCases.title: Physician-authored form
testCases.summary: The wallet renders a physician-authored form with conditional items and typed answers.
walletShows: The wallet renders every item type, shows conditional items only when their conditions are met, and accepts typed answers on the pen question.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows every answer, including typed pen-trouble answers.

testCases.title: Narrowed family
testCases.summary: A selector that takes any US Core profile but narrows it to Observation, for recent labs and vitals.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows the Observations.

testCases.title: No selector
testCases.summary: An item with no selector at all: the patient shares whatever they think is relevant.
walletShows: The wallet lets the patient choose.
verifierShows: The Verifier displays whatever arrives.

testCases.title: SMART Health Card
testCases.summary: The wallet answers an immunizations item with a SMART Health Card, which the request prefers over FHIR JSON.
verifierShows: The Verifier verifies the card's signature and shows its contents.

testCases.title: One artifact, several items
testCases.summary: One Bundle answers two items, and its fulfills lists both.

walletStep.text: Answer Allergies and Medications with one shared Bundle. Most wallets can't be asked to do this.

verifierShows: The Verifier attributes the resources to both items without counting them twice.

testCases.title: Cross-device
testCases.summary: A desktop browser shows a QR code, and the wallet on a phone answers it.

walletStep.text: Scan the QR code the desktop browser shows with the phone, and share everything.

verifierShows: The response arrives in the desktop page.

testCases.title: In-person handoff
testCases.summary: A front-desk QR code or kiosk lands the patient's phone on the Verifier's check-in page.

walletStep.text: Open the check-in page on the phone from the front-desk QR code or kiosk, then share everything.

verifierShows: The same as M2, with the handoff shown.

testCases.title: Prefilled form
testCases.summary: The wallet prefills form answers from the patient's records and lets the patient edit them.
walletShows: Prefilled answers are visible to the patient before sending.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows the answers.

testCases.title: Write back
testCases.summary: The Verifier files returned data and answers into the chart after staff review.
verifierShows: Staff can accept or reject each item.

testCases.title: Unknown selector
testCases.summary: The wallet answers an item whose selector kind it doesn't know as unsupported, and still answers the rest.
verifierShows: The Verifier shows the unknown item as unsupported and the demographics normally.
